svg.title: Mira's cognitive work
svg.desc: A bounded cognitive episode connects Jobs, current evidence and historical context, semantic memory, Findings, durable text and image Workspaces, camera snapshots, configured vision, communication, and one-shot follow-ups. All tool relationships depend on runtime authority and budgets.
